record.one_liner: Supabase provides an open source Firebase alternative built on top of a full Postgres database with auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, Auth, Storage, and Realtime functionality.

auth_methods.quote: Supabase Auth uses JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication.

api_type.quote: Supabase provides a RESTful API using PostgREST , a thin API layer on top of Postgres. It exposes everything you need from a CRUD API at the URL https://<project_ref>.supabase.co/rest/v1/ .

api_breadth.quote: The reflected API is designed to retain as much of Postgres' capability as possible including: Basic CRUD operations (Create/Read/Update/Delete) Arbitrarily deep relationships among tables/views, functions that return table types can also nest related tables/views.

official_mcp.quote: Connect Supabase to your AI assistants supabase.com/mcp
